answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. Each identity files a sonnet of fourteen receipts, one line per partner, each key-signed. A raven carries it to audit. Fakes trade in a closed loop, so their distinct-partner delta is near zero; shared partners count once. At 10 credits per receipt, 1,000 fakes need 14,000 partners and 140,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent already trades with fourteen partners and keeps its share.
